svg.title: A reviewed Terraform plan can pass, stop or require a new decision
svg.desc: A fictional source proposal and an actual providerless Terraform plan form one candidate change. The application compares owner, narrow action, exact scope and emergency setting with a separately reviewed intent. A wildcard permission or changed owner is rejected without apply. An emergency pause that differs from the approved value is held for a human decision and updated approved record. Only a matching plan applies to disposable local terraform_data state, followed by a fresh no-op plan. This is not an AWS IAM, cloud deployment or customer-behavior test.

g.text: Read the plan before changing the system
One proposed change can end in three different decisions.
Owner, version, scope and actual terraform_data plan JSON.
One owner, narrow action, exact scope and pause value.
Wildcard action or changed owner; no apply.
Pause differs; hold for a human decision.
Match intent; apply locally, then check no-op.
Local gate only: no AWS IAM, deployment or customer result tested.
